title: An operator-theoretic characterization of Gaussian measure singularity under mean shifts
summary: For two Gaussian random elements on a separable Hilbert space with common covariance operator, the fourth-order moment tensor structure of their mixture admits an operator-valued representation obtained from the purely quadratic component of the class-conditional second moment. We identify the tensor mechanism generating the completely diagonal coefficients of this fourth-order representation after covariance standardization, and show that these coefficients are governed entirely by the coordinatewise Cameron-Martin energy of the mean shift.
